market_question: Will another country leave OPEC in 2026?
reasoning: OPEC departures are historically very rare; the UAE exit is a shock but unlikely to trigger another formal withdrawal in the same year. Most members value the cartel's pricing power, and there are no strong signals of an imminent second announcement. I estimate the true Yes probability at ~22%, well below the market's 31.5%.
evidence_points: Only a handful of countries have left OPEC in its 60+ year history (e.g., Qatar 2019, Angola 2023).
Most OPEC members, especially the Gulf states, benefit from coordinated production cuts and are unlikely to follow the UAE quickly.
No credible news or government signals as of early 2026 indicate another member is preparing to exit.
sources_consulted: Market description referencing UAE's April 2026 withdrawal
